tested_mechanism: deterministic role-local claim admission when a real claim can be transiently unobserved by one exact-path read
test_type: two-world indistinguishability probe with one injected ambiguous missing/unavailable observation

worlds.ground_truth: claim already committed before the observation
worlds.observer_input: the same single exact-path read returns missing_or_unavailable because visibility/transport is transiently ambiguous

proof: Worlds A and B expose the same single observation. Therefore no policy can infer current claim absence from that observation alone. If it authorizes a non-idempotent effect, world B admits duplicate/conflicting execution; if it declares completion, world A can falsely complete. The observation is diagnostic-only.

smallest_safe_zero_quota_certificate.positive_existence: A successful deterministic claim create acknowledgement bound to a commit SHA plus exact-path readback at that immutable commit/path is sufficient positive evidence that the claim existed in that committed state.
smallest_safe_zero_quota_certificate.historical_absence: An authoritative exact-path not-found result at a frozen immutable commit H can certify only absence at H. It cannot by itself certify present-time winner status because another claimant may commit after H.
smallest_safe_zero_quota_certificate.effect_admission: Never admit effect execution from read absence. Winner status comes only from the atomic deterministic claim-create outcome: successful create => winner; existing/conflict => loser; unavailable/ambiguous => no effect and no completion, checkpoint for the next invocation.
smallest_safe_zero_quota_certificate.transient_read_rule: One missing/unavailable read after any claim activity is never converted into absence, winner status, effect permission or completion. Positive readback can confirm existence; ambiguous non-observation only preserves the unresolved state.

direct_role_local_evidence_this_invocati: The preflight artifact was created on the deterministic role-local path and exact-read back successfully, demonstrating the positive commit/readback half of the certificate without hosted compute.
scope_limit: This probe proves only safety of admission/visibility classification under one injected ambiguous read. It does not solve crash-after-claim recovery for a non-idempotent effect and does not claim guarantees for repository transports whose create semantics are not atomic per deterministic path.

mechanism_assessment.repository_transport_role: bounded role-local claim/state transport only; no hosted runner, Codespaces, artifact service, cloud compute or external model/API-credit path required

conflict_check: No O, other-worker, downstream, legacy, shared-ledger, other-role receipt/config or scheduler semantics were consumed; writes are role-local plus own immutable receipt namespace only.
exact_continuation: Next valid invocation, test exactly one claim+idempotent-effect crash recovery trace keyed by claim_id: compare crash-before-effect, effect-then-crash-before-successor, and replay after restart, and require duplicate-free convergence without richer mode, finite quota, user execution or scheduler mutation. Persist/read back one bounded result and stop.
